sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', c.date)::date AS ds, SUM(s.sales) AS y FROM m5_sales_train s JOIN m5_calendar c ON s.d = c.d WHERE s.item_id = 'HOBBIES_1_126' AND s.store_id = 'CA_4' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY ds ASC;
sql_explanation: The query calculates the total sales (y) for the specified product (HOBBIES_1_126) at the specified store (CA_4), aggregated by quarter (quarter granularity). It uses DATE_TRUNC('quarter', c.date) to set the time index (ds) to the start of each quarter.
